entries.title: Birth
entries.description: Born on 23 September 1991 in Khambhat, Gujarat, into a Tamil-Brahmin family long settled in the state. The opening frame of everything that follows.

entries.title: School: KV Cambay (classes 1-5)
entries.description: Early schooling at Kendriya Vidyalaya, Cambay (classes 1 to 5). The first classrooms, the first habits of attention.
entries.notes: CORRECTED schools. No "Anupam Group". That was a SEMCOM internship.

entries.title: Family settled in Anand
entries.description: The family put down roots in Anand, Gujarat. The town that would hold my school years, my college, my first studio, and eventually my company.
entries.notes: User-confirmed

entries.title: School: KV VVN (classes 6-10)
entries.description: Middle and high school at Kendriya Vidyalaya, Vallabh Vidyanagar (classes 6 to 10).

entries.title: School: Angels HS Anand (11-12 commerce)
entries.description: Classes 11 and 12 in the commerce stream at Angels High School, Anand. A business grounding that would later make running a one-person studio feel natural.

entries.title: SEMCOM 2nd-year internship: Anupam Industries (GIDC Anand)
entries.description: A second-year internship at Anupam Industries in the GIDC Anand industrial estate. An early, formative look at how real businesses actually run on the factory floor.
entries.notes: CORRECTED: Anupam was never his school. Schools: KV Cambay (1-5), KV VVN (6-10), Angels HS Anand (11-12 commerce)

entries.title: Multiple photography competition wins - national + state level
entries.description: Recognized with several state and national awards in photography competitions during my college years. This milestone marked the formal beginning of my trajectory as a photographer, bridging early passion with competitive validation.

entries.title: First-ever sent email
entries.description: My first email ever, subject line 'ur pic', sent to my sister with her photographs attached. Day zero of a digital trail that this entire archive is built on.
entries.notes: DAY ZERO of digital trail

entries.title: BBA(IT) starts
entries.description: Began a Bachelor of Business Administration in Information Technology at SEMCOM, Vallabh Vidyanagar. The campus that would shape the next decade, from student to visiting faculty.

entries.title: AIESEC induction
entries.description: Inducted into AIESEC on 14 October 2010. The day my structured creative life began, and the start of a decade of design, leadership, and the friendships that would shape my career.
entries.notes: Echoes 11yr later: Oct 14 2021 NEAR grant

entries.title: First design Work
entries.description: Stepping up to my very first commercial brief, this project marked the true beginning of my visual design journey. Tasked with promoting the AIESEC Global Internship Youth Fair, I installed Photoshop for the first time and relied purely on raw intuition to craft the event posters. This foundational 'vibe design' laid the groundwork for my self-taught path into professional graphic design.
entries.notes:
The Brief: Create promotional posters for the AIESEC OGX (Outgoing Global Exchange) Fair in VVN.

The Milestone: First commercial design brief; first time ever installing and using Adobe Photoshop.

entries.title: First t-shirt designed
entries.description: Designed my first-ever t-shirt, the front graphic for an AIESEC OGX Fair tee. An early step from screen design into things people could actually wear.

entries.title: First photoshoot
entries.description: A pivotal milestone marking my first paid photography commission. Following a chance encounter at a Mumbai coffee shop, I was hired to execute a commercial photoshoot for a boutique nail salon in Bandra, laying the groundwork for my subsequent commercial career.

entries.title: AIESEC VP Communications
entries.description: Led the communications strategy and visual identity for AIESEC Vidyanagar. In this core officer role, I managed the end-to-end communications function: designing promotional posters, driving targeted recruitment campaigns, and building comprehensive branding for large-scale conferences.
entries.notes: Sparse Gmail trail; LinkedIn-confirmed

entries.title: Elected Local Committee Coordinator
entries.description: Elected Local Committee Coordinator for AIESEC Vidyanagar, the top role in the chapter, leading its expansion across VVN and reporting to the Baroda leadership. My first taste of running an organisation rather than just a project.
entries.notes: First leadership role

entries.title: JNC 2012 + GoGujarat
entries.description: Led the local committee through JNC 2012 and the GoGujarat initiative, coordinating delegates, branding, and logistics across one of AIESEC's busiest conference seasons.

entries.title: First Short Films - Film Festival
entries.description: An exhilarating early milestone in my filmmaking journey. Collaborating with Parth Brahmbhatt, we proudly represented SEMCOM on a massive stage, showcasing two original short films at the prestigious Mithibai Kshitij festival in Mumbai. Stepping into the energy of a major student festival and watching our stories come to life on the big screen was a foundational rush that permanently hooked me on the craft of cinema.

entries.title: First client - Greenopia
entries.description: Marking a pivotal moment in my creative journey, this project represents my very first official freelance engagement. What began as a rapid, single-day turnaround for a Greenopia Facebook cover art brief quickly blossomed into a trusted, ongoing working relationship that spanned the rest of 2012. It remains a proud foundational milestone that kickstarted my professional career.
entries.notes:
Deliverable: Custom Facebook Cover Art and digital social media assets.

Significance: First official paid client, demonstrating early capabilities in rapid delivery (24-hour turnaround) and client retention.

entries.title: Visiting Card Design
entries.description: A clean visiting-card design commission. Small in scope, but part of the steady early freelance work that taught me to turn a brief around fast and keep a client happy.
entries.notes: College friend. Also shot his wedding.

entries.title: BBA(IT) graduates
entries.description: Graduated with a BBA in Information Technology from SEMCOM. The formal close of my student years and the runway into full-time creative work.

entries.title: NID prep: Bhanwar Rathod Academy
entries.description: A year of preparation for the National Institute of Design at Bhanwar Rathod's academy. The entrance didn't take, but the discipline of building a portfolio and thinking in design fundamentals stayed with me for good.
entries.notes: CRITICAL gap-fill

entries.title: Mathura wedding shoot: Kumar Jaivardhan (Indian Oil)
entries.description: A beautiful, fast-paced dive into the heart of Uttar Pradesh. Coordinated through an Indian Oil refinery connection, this destination booking took me to the ancient, vibrant streets of Mathura to document the wedding of Kumar Jaivardhan. Navigating an unfamiliar landscape and a completely new cultural rhythm, this shoot was a thrilling masterclass in adaptability, proving that no matter the location, the camera always finds a universal language in celebration.

entries.title: Pep and Joss corporate film
entries.description: Finding poetry in the mechanical heart of GIDC Anand. Taking the wheel as Director and Cinematographer for Pep and Joss, I stepped onto the factory floor to turn raw industrial grit into a compelling visual story. Balancing the sharp glare of machinery with the human rhythm of the workforce, this project was an exhilarating exercise in framing texture, scale, and functional beauty, resulting in a digital asset that continues to tell its story online.

entries.title: TGES/Schoogle - Team Lead Design
entries.description: This role was a massive turning point in my career. Joining TGES-Schoogle, an ed-tech startup in Ahmedabad, marked my official transition from a solo creative into a management position. Instead of just executing designs myself, I was suddenly responsible for guiding a tight-knit team of three designers. It was an incredible learning curve in balancing creative direction with the realities of team leadership and cross-department collaboration.
entries.evidenceDetail: Confirmed by user; emails under tges-schoogle domain
entries.notes:
The Role: First official, paid management position.

The Industry: In-house ed-tech (TGES-Schoogle based in Ahmedabad).

Key Responsibilities: Managing a 3-person design team and coordinating cross-departmental creative requirements.

entries.title: Wedding shoots
entries.description: A decade of capturing intimate celebrations and cultural milestones across Gujarat. Over this extensive timeline, I provided freelance photography services for a wide variety of clients, documenting weddings with a focus on candid storytelling, environmental portraiture, and high-stakes event execution.

entries.title: Jepoor - Jaipur travel film
entries.description: Produced and filmed a self-directed travel documentary showcasing the architectural and cultural heritage of Jaipur, Rajasthan. Managed all aspects of the independent production pipeline, including location scouting, cinematography, and creative direction.

entries.title: Niyati Patel wedding (Payal Di Shoot)
entries.description: The true genesis of my wedding photography journey. This shoot for Niyati Patel, affectionately marked as the 'Payal Di Shoot', holds a special place in my archives as my first-ever documented wedding commission. Stepping into the vibrant, high-stakes chaos of a traditional celebration for the first time, this project was a masterclass in split-second intuition, candid framing, and capturing raw human emotion. It set the baseline for over a decade of documenting love stories across Gujarat.

entries.title: Chhello Divas releases (cult classic)
entries.description: The public release of Chhello Divas on 20 November 2015, the Gujarati comedy that became a genuine cult classic. My behind-the-scenes stills and BTS footage went on to gather well over half a million combined views on YouTube, making it the most-seen and most-cherished credit of my early film career.
entries.notes: FIRST MAJOR FILM CREDIT

entries.title: Chhello Divas - Stills + BTS
entries.description: An electric, unforgettable chapter on the set of Krishnadev Yagnik’s Gujarati cult classic, Chhello Divas. As Unit Still Photographer and BTS videographer, I lived behind the lens, capturing the raw chemistry of the cast, the kinetic energy of the crew, and the quiet moments in between the chaos. Seeing those behind-the-scenes glimpses later explode into a collective 539,000+ views on YouTube was an incredible validation of a project that remains the most-viewed, deeply cherished creative milestone of my early career.
entries.notes: Unit Still Photographer + BTS. Most-viewed creative work of career.

entries.title: Sameer Movie - unit still photographer + BTS
entries.description: Served as the Unit Still Photographer and Behind-the-Scenes (BTS) documentarian for the feature film Sameer, produced by Nomad Movies Pvt Ltd. Responsible for capturing promotional production stills and managing on-set asset documentation. This project marked my second feature film engagement of 2015.

entries.title: First Showreel published
entries.description: Compiled and published the first formal cinematography showreel, establishing a centralized portfolio of early film and video work. The reel serves as the baseline technical index for subsequent commercial, narrative, and corporate video productions.

entries.title: SEMCOM Visiting Faculty starts
entries.description: Began teaching as Visiting Faculty at SEMCOM, returning to my own college to mentor students in advertising, film, and design production. A relationship with the campus that has now run for the better part of a decade.

entries.title: SEMCOM Visiting Faculty: ad film production outcomes
entries.description: Taught digital media marketing, cinematography, film editing, blockchain. Student outcome: helped them understand ad film production. That year's ad-making competition produced notably good films from students.
entries.notes: Already in MASTER as row 52. This is the enriched version with outcome detail.

entries.title: Pondicherry travel film
entries.description: Executed the independent direction and cinematography for a dedicated travel film centered on Pondicherry. Managed the end-to-end visual styling, framing, and camera operations for the independent project layout

entries.title: Art Director - Patel vs Patrik(unreleased feature)
entries.description: Appointed as Art Director for the feature film Patel VS Patrik, produced by Dhwani Gautam Films. Responsible for the project's overall visual design, set styling, and scenic layouts. While the film ultimately remained unreleased due to production halts, this project marked my first official credit as an Art Director on a feature-length film.

entries.title: Art Director - Map Oil TVC
entries.description: Served as Art Director for a national television commercial for MAP Premium Edible Oils. Responsible for the overall visual aesthetic and set design, coordinating closely with production teams to deliver broadcast-ready commercial assets. This project marked my first official television commercial credit.
entries.notes: NEW: FIRST TVC Art Direction credit

entries.title: Diana rescued, with Nahush from Ahmedabad streets
entries.description: Rescued Diana from the streets of Ahmedabad with Nahush. Eleven years of companionship that have outlasted most jobs, cities, and plans.
entries.notes: Diana. Nahush Shukla co-rescuer. Date: 23 Jan 2017.

entries.title: Pixelate co-founded
entries.description: Co-founded with Ronak Pamin + Pranav Burnwal. Concept: AMM for camera-sensor photographs ("Pixel Tokens"). Token = whitepaper only, never shipped.
entries.notes: Ronak email: ronakpamin@gmail.com. NEAR Medium had "Amin", to confirm.

entries.title: Won Startupweekend banglore challenge (54hr)
entries.description: Won the 54-hour Startup Weekend Bangalore challenge with the Pixelate team. A sleepless, high-pressure sprint from idea to pitch that validated the blockchain direction we would chase for the next few years.

entries.title: Europe trip
entries.description: An immersive photographic journey across Europe. Over the course of this trip through Italy, France, the Netherlands, and Belgium, I focused on capturing the distinct character of each region. From the historic streets of Rome and the Vatican to the Eiffel Tower and the canals of Amsterdam, this project was an exploration of European life and architecture through the lens.

entries.title: Pixelate Whitepaper drafted
entries.description: Drafted the Pixelate whitepaper, translating a sprawling set of ideas about decentralised creative ownership into a structured technical and economic document. The blueprint that anchored the venture.

entries.title: Tosha wedding film
entries.description: Crafting an intimate, cinematic heirloom for Tosha's beautiful celebration in Ankleshwar. Stepping into this project as both Cinematographer and Editor, I wanted to move past standard documentation and truly capture the unspoken glances, the heavy emotions, and the vibrant festive energy. The final film, archived beautifully as Tosha's Bride Book, stands as a heartfelt testament to the power of unscripted, human-centric storytelling.

entries.title: Certified Blockchain Expert
entries.description: Earned formal certification as a Blockchain Expert, putting rigorous foundations under the self-taught web3 work and giving the Pixelate venture real technical credibility.
entries.notes: FIRST PRO CERTIFICATION

entries.title: Tarikshir book promotion and marketing
entries.description: For this partnership, I wore two hats: event promoter and digital creative lead. First, I managed the international marketing and on-ground launch for his novel Tarikshir in Dubai. Beyond the hype of the book release, I also took charge of his ongoing personal brand: designing his social aesthetic, curating his content, and giving his readers a reason to stay connected with him long after they finished the book.
entries.notes:
Scope: International event promotion & ongoing personal brand management.

The Launch: Managed on-ground marketing and social buzz for the Tarikshir release in Dubai (my first international work trip!).

The Brand: Acted as creative lead for Khayaal’s ongoing digital persona, handling daily content creation, grid curation, and community building.

entries.title: Music video: The Other Woman ft. Iti
entries.description: Executed direction and cinematography for an independent music video project featuring a performance by Iti. Managed the end-to-end production workflow, framing, and visual aesthetics.

entries.title: CVM College of Fine Arts: Guest Lecturer
entries.description: Invited to guest-lecture at CVM College of Fine Arts, sharing working-industry practice in film and design with fine-arts students and bridging the gap between the classroom and live commercial work.
entries.notes: FIRST GUEST LECTURE

entries.title: Arahantas - 5 months Himachal (volunteer event promoter)
entries.description: A deliberate detour into the Himalayas. Over a five-month stay in Himachal Pradesh, I spent three months volunteering at Arahantas, trading commercial commissions for grassroots action. I managed weekend events, engaged with the community face-to-face, and handled their daily promotional needs: whipping up event posters and social media posts on the fly. This immersive, hands-on chapter served as a grounding prelude to my later brand commissions for the space.

entries.title: OCTO Advisory Research Associate
entries.description: Joined OCTO Advisory as a Research Associate, running market analysis on the collaboration-software landscape. A disciplined stretch of structured research and synthesis alongside the creative practice.
entries.notes: FIRST CORPORATE RESEARCH ROLE

entries.title: "The Human Eye and its collective visual knowledge"
entries.description: Researched and wrote 'The Human Eye and its Collective Visual Knowledge', an essay drawing my photography practice and my curiosity about perception into a single line of thought.

entries.title: Jadi Duty - Brand Identity
entries.description: Crafted a grounded yet contemporary brand identity and packaging system for Jadi Duty, an herbal wellness brand. The core design challenge was presenting traditional Ayurvedic supplements, specifically Ashwagandha, Moringa, and Giloy capsules, in a fresh, modern context. The resulting visual language utilizes a soothing, earth-toned palette and a structured, apothecary-inspired grid system for the bottle wraps and box layouts, ensuring the products feel both deeply trustworthy and refreshingly modern on the shelf.
entries.notes:
Scope: Core Brand Identity & Packaging Design.

Deliverables: Custom geometric iconography, color palette, bottle wrap labels, and outer box layouts for three distinct SKU lines (Ashwagandha, Moringa, and Giloy).

Design Strategy: Utilizing a modular, grid-based layout to balance regulatory supplement information with a clean, modern aesthetic.

entries.title: NEAR Blockchain Accelerator bootcamp begins
entries.description: Joined the NEAR Protocol accelerator bootcamp as a co-founder, formalising the Pixelate venture inside a serious web3 ecosystem and learning to build and pitch on a global stage.
entries.notes: FIRST INCUBATOR

entries.title: $15,000 NEAR Fast Grant deposited
entries.description: The $15,000 NEAR Fast Grant landed on 14 October 2021, exactly eleven years to the day after my AIESEC induction. The single largest grant of my career, and a quiet, almost cinematic rhyme between where I started and where the work had carried me.
entries.notes: FIRST MAJOR GRANT: $15K.

entries.title: Haus of Pixels OPC Pvt Ltd incorporated
entries.org: Haus of Pixels OPC Pvt Ltd
entries.description: Incorporated Haus of Pixels OPC Pvt Ltd in Anand (CIN U72900GJ2022OPC131119), giving the practice a legal home. The moment a freelance creative life became an actual company with my name as sole owner-director.
entries.notes: FIRST REGISTERED COMPANY

entries.title: Workshop on Wheels (WOW) brand identity
entries.description: Engineered a dynamic and cohesive brand identity for WOW (Workshop on Wheels). Tasked with visualizing the concept of a mobile automotive workshop, I designed a versatile logo and extended the brand's visual language across both print and digital platforms. The resulting identity captures the energy, mechanical expertise, and seamless convenience of their at-home vehicle servicing.
entries.notes:
Deliverables: Primary/Secondary Logo, Website UI/UX, Print Collateral (Business cards, service menus).

Specialized Assets: Vehicle wrap/livery design (if applicable: a huge selling point for mobile businesses).

Key Challenge/Goal: Balancing the rugged, trustworthy feel of an automotive garage with the sleek, modern convenience of an app-like on-demand service.

entries.title: Silver Dragon rebranding
entries.description: Designed a bold, modernized brand identity for Silver Dragon, a 25-year-old legacy Indo-Chinese restaurant in Vallabh Vidyanagar. Crafted under Haus of Pixels Studio, the refreshed visual system introduces a striking new primary logo and a vibrant color palette, effectively elevating the establishment for a contemporary audience while preserving its historical charm.
entries.notes:
Scope: Full visual identity overhaul for a 25-year-old legacy establishment.

Deliverables: Primary & Secondary Logos, Comprehensive Brand Guidelines (Logo Guideline), Brand Color Palette, and Typography System.

Key Challenge/Goal: Modernizing the visual aesthetic of a highly established local restaurant without alienating its multi-generational customer base.

entries.title: MK Engineering Works branding
entries.description: Developed a striking and robust brand identity for MK Engineering Works, a specialized manufacturer of industrial and defense parts. The modernized visual system features a precise, geometric logo and a high-visibility color palette that perfectly encapsulates the workshop's technical expertise, efficiency, and industrial strength
entries.notes:
Deliverables: Primary logo design, brand color palette, and corporate stationery (such as the invoice templates visible in your mockup).

Key Challenge/Goal: Modernizing heavy industrial branding while maintaining a sense of durability, extreme precision, and trust suitable for defense sector clients.

entries.title: Portfolio 2023 published
entries.description: A curated anthology of my creative journey up to 2023. This massive 24-module Behance presentation serves as a visual archive, bringing together diverse brand identities, visual systems, and personal milestones into a single, cohesive narrative that reflects my evolution as a designer.
entries.notes:
Format: 24-module digital compendium published on Behance.

Scope: Curating, formatting, and presenting a multi-year archive of commercial and personal design work.

Milestone: Establishing a unified visual language for my own personal brand and creative identity.

entries.title: House of Glam branding
entries.description: Crafted a luxurious new brand identity for House of Glam. Tasked with revamping this local beauty space, I designed a visual system that embodies modern elegance and timeless glamour. The centerpiece of the identity is a bold, classic serif monogram set against a rich, textured gold motif. This elevated aesthetic translates seamlessly across their brand touchpoints, perfectly reflecting the premium, high-quality beauty services they offer.
entries.notes:
Deliverables: Primary and secondary logos, brand color palette, typography selection, and brand guidelines.

Key Challenge/Goal: Elevating a local salon into a premium, high-end beauty destination through sophisticated visual communication.

entries.title: Cross.pet brand iDENTITY - For Sale
entries.description: Designed a bold, highly recognizable brand identity for cross.pet, a modern online pet store. The visual system is anchored by a playful, oversized logo mark that translates seamlessly from a digital e-commerce environment to striking physical packaging and merchandise.
entries.notes:
Deliverables: Primary logo design, brand color palette, typography selection, and packaging/merchandise design.

Key Challenge/Goal: Creating a distinct, memorable mark that works just as effectively as a digital avatar or website header as it does on physical shipping materials.

entries.title: Yogesh Khaman LED content
entries.description: An absolute masterclass in commercial food storytelling. Directing and shooting the promotional media for Yogesh Khaman was all about making the frame feel incredibly alive and appetizing. Working with high-brightness LED content layout requirements meant focusing heavily on bold color separation, macro textures, and intentional lighting. It was a thrilling creative sprint that proved even the most traditional local flavors deserve premium, cinematic craftsmanship.
entries.notes:
30+ year old khaman shop. LED screen content for new outlet
Conducted full product photoshoot and then turned the photos repository into multiple seasonal slideshow for LED screen

entries.title: Miss Serena Nanawati music video
entries.description: Stepping into the controlled chaos of the studio to craft a distinct visual universe. For this music video with Serena Nanawati, I wore two hats as Art Director and Cinematographer-orchestrating everything from the initial shot design and lighting architecture to the final camera movements. It was an exhilarating exercise in pure creative control, translating musical rhythm into a rich, atmospheric cinematic experience.

entries.title: Arahantas Yoga Studio brand
entries.description: Translating the serene, meditative heartbeat of Dharamkot into a cohesive visual identity. Taking charge of the brand's layout, I captured the daily rhythm of the space through intentional photography, while designing social media content and event posters that mirrored its quiet energy. This project was a beautiful exercise in organic storytelling using design not just to fill a grid, but to build a visual bridge between a soulful space and its global community.

entries.title: KindHealth folder formally created
entries.description: The opening move on KindHealth as co-founder, setting up the structure and groundwork for a health-tech venture and beginning to shape what the product and brand could become.

entries.title: KindHealth Financial Model
entries.description: Built out the KindHealth financial model, pressure-testing the venture's economics and turning an early-stage idea into numbers a co-founding team could actually plan and raise against.

entries.title: Its a Baby! Studios  - Brand Identity
entries.description: Spearheaded the complete visual identity for Vadodara-based Its A Baby! Studios, marking my most extensive single-client deliverable of 2024. This comprehensive branding package required translating a playful, energetic aesthetic across a massive suite of assets. The final rollout included a foundational brand book, a series of six distinct brochures, corporate stationery, custom apparel, and large-scale outdoor hoardings, ensuring a highly cohesive and impactful brand presence across all physical and digital touchpoints.
entries.notes:
Scope: End-to-end brand identity rollout.

Print & Digital Deliverables: Brand Guidelines, Brochures (x6), Stationery (Letterhead, Business Cards, Invoice Templates), Apparel (Tees), and Large Format Displays (Banners, Hoardings).

Key Challenge/Achievement: Maintaining consistent brand colors, typography, and playful character elements across highly varied print and digital formats.

entries.title: Singapore/Malaysia - Travel film (Flamingo Travels)
entries.description: A beautiful full-circle moment in my journey behind the lens. Ever since I first picked up a camera, shooting a massive, multi-country international travel campaign was the ultimate dream and this project with Flamingo Travels Ahmedabad was exactly that. Documenting a whirlwind 10-trip expedition across the vibrant streetscapes and iconic skylines of Singapore and Malaysia, I poured every ounce of my creative energy into the frame, turning a bucket-list milestone into a living, breathing cinematic reality
entries.evidenceDetail: "Top 5 things to do in Singapore" + "Highlights Travel Video Malaysia & Singapore" Jun 2024

entries.title: Latvia/Riga: health-tech cofounding + DEPORTATION
entries.description: A health-tech co-founding stint in Riga, Latvia that ended abruptly in deportation. A short, sharp chapter abroad that closed a door but sharpened my read on where, and with whom, to build next.
entries.notes: CRITICAL: not a Cynsar trip. Deportation + Pixelate end + KindHealth stall = 2024 triple-failure cluster.

entries.title: Mankind Pharma Internal AV
entries.description: Bringing high-production energy to internal brand messaging. For this Mankind Pharma project, I wore both the Director and Editor hats, allowing me to meticulously sculpt the film's rhythm and tone from the first frame to the final cut. It was a fantastic exercise in maintaining visual interest and storytelling impact within a traditional corporate framework, proving that internal films deserve just as much creative soul as a broadcast ad.

entries.title: Pixelate formally ENDS
entries.description: Pixelate formally wound down. After years of building, granting, and pitching, drawing the line on the venture was its own kind of milestone, clearing the ground for everything that came after.
entries.notes: 7-YEAR ARC ENDS (Mar 2017 → Jul 2024)

entries.title: Auroville volunteering
entries.description: Volunteered with Auroville's consulting community, accepted into an energy-policy analyst track among a wave of roles I applied to in a single decisive week. A deliberate reset toward purpose-led work after the Pixelate chapter closed.

entries.title: Visual designer Consultant - Rabble Labs
entries.description: Acted as a core Visual Design Consultant for Rabble Labs and Buidlerstribe, partnering directly with the Product, Growth, and Business Development teams. My primary focus was building out robust brand identities, specifically for Rabble Labs and Scribble, and translating those guidelines into scalable, high-quality design systems. By creating flexible templates and assets, I empowered the wider team to maintain visual consistency across all touchpoints.
entries.notes:
Brand & UI: Brand Identities (Rabble Labs, Scribble), Product Design, Graphic Layouts, and Custom Illustrations.

Marketing & Content: Social Media Templates, Audio-Visual Content, Infographics, and Generative AI Content.

Business Strategy: Investor Pitch Decks and Proposal Documents.

entries.title: Production director - Buddy Tales animation series
entries.description: An incredible, highly collaborative journey into the world of independent animation. Teaming up with Savan Barot, two brilliant animators, and a dedicated background artist, I stepped into the dual role of Director and Producer to bring the Buddy Tales mini-series to life. From balancing tight remote pipelines with Shivanata Production LLP to orchestrating the visual rhythm of every frame, this project was a masterclass in collective imagination and pure storytelling passion.

entries.title: Conscious Cafe Menu
entries.description: Comprehensive menu design for Conscious Cafe, a prominent and beloved establishment in Pondicherry. The project focused on establishing a clean, modern visual hierarchy and elegant typography to beautifully showcase their diverse offerings, from artisanal house-made kombuchas to specialty coffees and floral teas. The resulting design elevates the brand's aesthetic while ensuring a seamless and engaging ordering experience for patrons.
entries.notes:
Deliverables: Print-ready menu layouts, digital menu adaptations, typography selection, and layout strategy.

Key Challenge/Goal: Balancing a large variety of categories (kombucha, slow juices, floral teas) without cluttering the page.

entries.title: Green Silk Road Map Portal
entries.description: Ongoing tech-contracting on the Green Silk Road map portal, handling database support and the data plumbing behind an interactive mapping product.

entries.title: First College Ad film
entries.description: Executed the direction and cinematography for a student-led college ad film campaign. Directed the end-to-end production pipeline and visual layout. The ad film was awarded at the college ad film festival.

entries.title: Gujarat tourism AD films
entries.description: Served as Art Director and Production Associate for a series of state-level commercial ad films commissioned by Gujarat Tourism. Collaborated with Talk of the Town Media to oversee scenic design, spatial layouts, and on-ground production logistics, ensuring alignment with campaign objectives and brand guidelines.
